top_signals.title: Gold Steadies as Traders Assess US-Iran Tensions, Fed Rate Path
top_signals.summary: Gold was steady after rising moderately the previous day, as traders assessed Middle East tensions following President Donald Trump’s comments that the US wouldn’t attack Iran before November midterm elections.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Drop on Tech Jitters, Oil Edges Lower: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks dropped, tracking declines on Wall Street, as speculation about OpenAI’s revenue revived concerns over the sustainability of the artificial-intelligence spending boom. Oil edged lower.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Inflation on many everyday items was entirely due to tariffs, NY Fed says
top_signals.summary: Tariffs added 2.9 percentage points to inflation in 67 categories of goods by February 2026, researchers at the New York Federal Reserve found.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Activities of U.S. Affiliates of Foreign Multinational Enterprises, 2024
top_signals.summary: Majority-owned U.S. affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises employed 8.57 million workers in the United States in 2024, a 0.2 percent increase from 8.56 million workers in 2023, according to statistics on U.S. affiliate operations and finances released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis.
